content:
Bihar School Examination Board has an active form or counselling update for Bihar BSEB DElEd 2026 Common Application Form.

Counselling schedules, mop-up rounds and last dates change quickly. Use the official counselling or board portal for choice filling and allotment.

What to do

  1. Visit www.biharboardonline.bihar.gov.in
  2. Register or log in
  3. Fill the form or choices and upload documents
  4. Pay the counselling / form fee if asked
editorNotes: Independent listing for candidates. NaukriMitra is not a government website. Always open the official recruiting-body URL before paying a fee or relying on a result.
importantInstructions: Do not share login OTPs. Download PDFs only from the official domain. Dates and vacancy counts on aggregator sites can lag behind the notice.
